review: The middle Big Brother, or, for short, Ricardo Heathcliff, is a brand-new addition to the Envy resonance team, an infamous archetype known for its rather heated discussions. Regardless of that, let’s look into what Ricardo Heathcliff brings to the team and dig into the truth about the Envy team's future. Starting with his passives, he has three. The first 2 are free and always active and we can divide them into 2 categories. The first Passive revolves around his S3-2 and extra S3-1 whenever he gets into the field. On top of that, allies that are being hit inflict Vendetta Mark and give Book of Vengeance stacks for Heathcliff. This part of his kit literally plays itself, so there is no need for extra explanation.
